metadata.compatibility_policy: Version-pinned compatibility for Kestra YAML, Pebble expressions, REST API, CLI, execution semantics and documented import/export formats, plus AMESH-specific capabilities.
notes: Accepted product decisions are tracked in docs/product/decision-register.md.
A requirement is not Verified until linked evidence exists.
A full compatibility claim requires green differential evidence for every declared interface surface.
PostgreSQL is the only reference metadata database and internal durable transport.
Python 3.12 asyncio is the accepted production backend for the durable control plane (ADR-016); the checked-in foundation is the production engine seed.
The first production reference environment is on-premises Kubernetes.
The accepted v1 scale qualification target is profile M: 100,000 executions/day, 1,000 active task runs, 50 task starts/s and 10 million retained execution records.
The first stable release uses the minimal recovery gate: RPO <= 48 hours and RTO <= 8 hours.
Migration depth includes resources, identity/governance configuration, execution history, logs, artifacts and audit evidence.
Architecture and evidence are designed for SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 readiness without claiming certification.
AGPL-3.0-only is final while AMESH remains open source.

nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Every agent message, routing decision, tool call, hand-off, approval and model response shall be traceable to pinned policy and execution context.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All catalogued mesh scenarios produce a complete provenance graph with no orphan tool effects.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Provenance graph completeness tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Memory and tool isolation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Agent memory, tools and credentials shall be isolated by tenant, namespace, execution and delegated capability.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero cross-boundary disclosure or unauthorised tool invocation in adversarial mesh tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Cross-tenant, prompt-injection and capability-confusion tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Provider portability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Core mesh state and policy shall remain usable when a model provider is disabled or replaced.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Reference meshes migrate between two conforming model adapters with documented output nondeterminism and no state-schema change.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Provider substitution and outage tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Independent verification
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Every AI-authored production change shall receive review and verification from agents that did not implement the change.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: 100% of protected-branch changes contain distinct implementer, reviewer and verifier identities.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Repository policy and pull-request evidence audit.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Contribution provenance
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: AI contributions shall preserve model, tool, input-source and artifact provenance without storing secrets or prohibited source material.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: 100% of AI-authored pull requests and releases have a valid provenance record and pass clean-room scans.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Provenance-schema, secret-scan and clean-room gate tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Autonomy isolation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Engineering agents shall operate with least privilege and shall not receive production credentials or unreviewed default-branch write access.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero production credentials in agent sandboxes and zero direct protected-branch mutations in policy tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Credential canary and branch-protection integration tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Deterministic release gates
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Merge and release eligibility shall be computed from reproducible policy and evidence rather than model confidence.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Repeated evaluation of the same evidence bundle produces the same eligibility result.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Golden evidence-bundle and policy replay tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Compact availability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: A production compact deployment shall support a documented high-availability topology.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: At least 99.9% monthly control-plane availability excluding declared maintenance.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Reference topology soak test and SLO calculation.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Distributed availability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The distributed topology shall tolerate loss of any one stateless service instance without operator intervention.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: No accepted work lost; service recovers within 60 seconds of instance loss.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Multi-replica chaos and zone-spread tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Reference recovery objectives
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The first stable release and later hardened profiles shall have documented and tested recovery point and recovery time objectives.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: First stable release gate: RPO <= 48 hours and RTO <= 8 hours. Post-GA hardened reference target: RPO <= 4 hours and RTO <= 4 hours; the tighter target is not a v1 release blocker.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Isolated restore exercise on the on-premises Kubernetes reference topology, with measured data-loss window and service-restoration time.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Safe maintenance
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Planned maintenance and rolling upgrades shall drain or transfer owned work without silent loss.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero lost accepted work and no more than one configured scheduling-delay window.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Upgrade and drain conformance suite.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: SOC 2 and ISO 27001 readiness
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The architecture, operating procedures and evidence model shall be designed for SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 readiness without representing readiness as certification.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Before GA, every applicable control has a versioned mapping to an owner, implementation, evidence source, collection cadence, test and recorded gap; certification itself is outside the v1 release gate.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Control-crosswalk validation and sample evidence-package review by an independent security or compliance reviewer.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Modular boundaries
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Core domain and reducer logic shall not depend directly on web frameworks, PostgreSQL claim mechanics, search projections or object-storage SDKs.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Architecture dependency tests enforce allowed module directions.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Static architecture test in CI.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Public contract compatibility
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Public DSL, API, event and plugin contracts shall follow documented semantic-versioning and deprecation rules.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: No breaking contract change enters a minor or patch release without an approved exception.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Automated schema and API compatibility checks.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Migration determinism
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Schema, event and resource migrations shall be repeatable and produce the same canonical result.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Repeated migration fixtures produce identical checksums.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Migration golden tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Test pyramid
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Every epic shall include unit, contract, integration or end-to-end evidence appropriate to its risk.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All Must requirements have at least one linked automated or manual verification record before GA.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Traceability validator and release gate.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Generated artifact freshness
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Generated schemas, SDKs, documentation, traceability files and issue bodies shall be reproducible and checked for drift.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Repository validation produces no uncommitted generated changes.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: CI regeneration and clean-tree check.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Dependency health
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Runtime dependencies shall have declared owners, update policy and license compatibility.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: No unknown-license dependency and no unwaived critical known vulnerability in a release.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Dependency and license scanning.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Health model
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Each service shall expose distinct liveness, readiness and detailed dependency health.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Reference orchestrator removes unready instances without restarting healthy but degraded processes unnecessarily.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Kubernetes and Compose health tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Bounded cardinality
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Operational metrics shall avoid unbounded tenant, flow, execution and task identifiers by default.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Metric cardinality remains within published limits under the standard scale test.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Telemetry cardinality audit.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Actionable alerts
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Reference alerts shall include symptom, likely causes, impact and runbook link.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All GA SLO alerts pass alert-quality review and simulated firing tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Alert fixture and runbook audit.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Support bundle safety
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Administrators shall be able to generate a redacted diagnostic bundle without exposing secrets or unrelated tenant data.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Canary-secret and cross-tenant scans pass for generated bundles.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Security test with seeded sensitive data.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Capacity visibility
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Operators shall see queue lag, worker capacity, admission pressure, database saturation, storage use and search lag.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All capacity signals are present in the reference dashboard and alert catalog.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Dashboard and telemetry contract tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Safe rollback guidance
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Every release containing irreversible migration or behavior change shall publish recovery and rollback guidance.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Release is blocked when migration classification lacks an operator procedure.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Release metadata validation.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: API latency
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Common authenticated read and write APIs shall remain responsive at the standard reference scale.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Provisional target: p95 below 500 ms and p99 below 1.5 s excluding bulk exports and external dependencies.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Repeatable load test with 10 million retained execution records and realistic filters.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Execution launch latency
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Accepted execution launches shall become visible and eligible for orchestration promptly.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Provisional target: p95 below 2 seconds and p99 below 5 seconds in the standard profile.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: End-to-end launch benchmark under mixed workload.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Schedule accuracy
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Due schedules shall create occurrences within a bounded delay under supported load.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Provisional target: p99 within 5 seconds of due time, excluding declared catch-up throttling.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Virtual-clock and real-time scheduler benchmark.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Dispatch throughput
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The distributed reference profile shall sustain task dispatch and completion processing without unbounded lag.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Profile M target: 50 task starts per second sustained for 60 minutes with p95 dispatch latency below 3 seconds and no unbounded queue lag.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Published benchmark on a fixed reference topology.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Concurrent workload
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The distributed reference profile shall support large numbers of active executions and task runs.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Profile M target: 1,000 active task runs while accepting at least 100,000 executions over a 24-hour mixed-workload qualification run.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Soak test with mixed short and long tasks.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Large workflow usability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The engine and UI shall handle executions with very large expanded task graphs.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Provisional target: 100,000 task runs per execution with aggregated UI views and bounded memory.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Synthetic large-DAG and loop benchmark.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Log ingestion
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Log ingestion shall not block task completion and shall apply explicit overload policy.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Provisional target: 50,000 log records per second per standard cluster with bounded buffers.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Burst and sustained log-load test with exporter outage.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Artifact streaming
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Large artifact transfer shall use streaming and bounded memory.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: A 10 GiB artifact transfers with less than 256 MiB process-memory growth per stream.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Storage adapter performance and memory profiling.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Horizontal scalability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Adding eligible service replicas shall increase throughput until a documented shared dependency becomes limiting.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: At least 70% scaling efficiency from two to four replicas on the reference distributed workload.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Comparative scale-out benchmark.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Reference scale profile M
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The v1 distributed reference deployment shall qualify against the accepted profile M workload on the documented on-premises Kubernetes topology.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: 100,000 executions per day, 1,000 active task runs, 50 sustained task starts per second and 10 million retained execution records.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Published 24-hour mixed-workload, retention-query and failure-recovery benchmark on a fixed bill of materials.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Open dependencies
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The self-hosted platform shall not require a proprietary control service or license server for any GA capability.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Air-gapped reference deployment passes the full core and governance acceptance suite.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Offline installation and test run.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Architecture portability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Official containers shall support linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Both architectures pass smoke and conformance tests for every stable release.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Multi-architecture release CI.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Boundary portability without multi-database promises
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Core transport semantics shall be isolated from PostgreSQL claim mechanics, while object storage, secret providers, model providers and task runners shall use documented capability interfaces.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: PostgreSQL remains the sole supported internal durable transport and metadata database; every backend category explicitly marked extensible passes its conformance suite.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Static architecture checks plus adapter contract tests for each extensible backend category.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Telemetry choice
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Product analytics and update checks shall be disabled by default or require an explicit informed opt-in.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: No undeclared outbound connection occurs in the offline network test.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Network capture in a clean reference deployment.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Data minimization
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The platform shall retain only data required by configured orchestration, audit and operational policy.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Data inventory maps every persisted field to purpose, retention and sensitivity.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Privacy and schema review.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Acknowledged-command durability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The platform shall not lose an accepted state-changing command after the API or durable PostgreSQL transport acknowledges it.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero lost acknowledged commands in crash-consistency and failover tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Fault-injection tests that terminate services and PostgreSQL connections at every commit, claim and acknowledgement boundary.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Idempotent redelivery
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The platform shall tolerate duplicate commands, events, trigger occurrences and task results without duplicate logical state transitions.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All conformance duplicate-injection scenarios produce one logical effect.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Property-based and integration tests with duplicate and reordered delivery.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Stale-owner fencing
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The platform shall prevent an expired scheduler, worker or service owner from committing after ownership transfers.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero accepted stale mutations in lease-expiry and partition tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Chaos tests with paused processes, network partitions and delayed completions.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Deterministic replay
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The execution reducer shall produce the same canonical state from the same ordered event stream and reducer version.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Byte-equivalent canonical snapshots across 100 repeated replays and supported platforms.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Golden event-stream and property-based reducer tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Graceful degradation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Core orchestration shall continue when optional search, telemetry, outbound webhook or analytics services are unavailable.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: New and running executions continue within documented latency budgets during optional-service outage tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Dependency isolation and outage integration tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Data integrity
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: All stored artifacts and imported bundles shall be protected by cryptographic checksums and corruption detection.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Every stored object has a verified checksum; corruption drills are detected before consumption.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Storage adapter conformance and corruption-injection tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Recovery convergence
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Automated reconciliation shall converge recoverable invariant violations without creating new violations.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Reference fault scenarios converge within 10 minutes after dependencies recover.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: End-to-end recovery suite with invariant counters.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Clock robustness
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Temporal decisions shall tolerate bounded clock skew and use monotonic time for local deadlines where possible.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Correct schedule, lease and timeout behavior with plus or minus 30 seconds node skew.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Virtual-clock and multi-node skew tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Tenant isolation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: No API, event, cache, log, metric, search, storage or plugin path shall expose one tenant's protected data to another.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero cross-tenant findings in adversarial isolation test suite and pre-GA penetration test.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Automated negative tests, database checks and independent penetration testing.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Least privilege
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Components, workers, plugins and runners shall receive only the identities and capabilities required for their role and current operation.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Reference deployments pass privilege review with no shared administrator credentials.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Threat-model review and deployment policy tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Secret non-disclosure
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Secret plaintext shall not appear in persistent metadata, events, logs, metrics, traces, UI payloads or generated support bundles.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Zero seeded canary secrets detected across persisted and exported telemetry in the security suite.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Canary-secret scanning and redaction tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Encryption in transit
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Production interfaces shall support modern TLS and authenticated internal transport where configured.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: TLS 1.2 or newer; weak ciphers disabled in reference configurations.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Automated protocol scan and reference deployment test.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Encryption at rest
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The platform shall support encrypted metadata, object storage and secret-provider configurations.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Documented reference configurations use provider-managed or customer-managed encryption keys.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Configuration audit and restore test.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Credential rotation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: User, service, component and provider credentials shall be rotatable without rebuilding application images.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Reference rotation procedures complete without losing accepted work.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Automated token, certificate and external-secret rotation tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Supply-chain provenance
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Official artifacts shall include verifiable source provenance, SBOM and signatures.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: 100% of official release artifacts have published checksums, SBOMs and signatures.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Release pipeline policy gate.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Untrusted workload isolation
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Untrusted user code and third-party plugins shall not execute inside the webserver, scheduler, executor or metadata database process.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All untrusted reference tasks and plugins run through isolated runners or plugin services.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Architecture test and runtime process inspection.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Audit completeness
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Security-relevant actions shall generate attributable audit records even when denied.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: 100% coverage of the audited-action catalog in automated tests.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Endpoint-to-audit traceability suite.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Secure defaults
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Fresh production-oriented configurations shall fail closed for authentication, plugin trust, network exposure and secrets.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Security baseline scanner reports no critical unsafe defaults.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Configuration conformance and container scan.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Authoring feedback
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Flow validation shall return actionable errors tied to source locations.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: p95 validation response below 1 second for a 5,000-line flow; every error includes code and location.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Editor benchmark and validation contract tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Operational explainability
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: State, admission, retry, cache, policy and authorization decisions shall expose human-readable evidence to authorized users.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Decision evidence is present in all catalogued decision scenarios.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Scenario-based UI and API acceptance tests.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: First-run success
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: A new contributor shall be able to start the reference stack and run a sample flow from documented steps.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: Median completion below 20 minutes on a clean supported workstation, excluding image download time.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Quarterly external documentation usability test.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Accessibility
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: The GA web interface shall conform to WCAG 2.2 AA for supported workflows.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: No critical or serious automated findings and manual keyboard and screen-reader acceptance.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Automated accessibility scan plus manual audit.

nonfunctional_requirements.title: Error safety
nonfunctional_requirements.statement: Destructive UI and CLI operations shall present impact, scope and recovery consequences before execution.
nonfunctional_requirements.target: All destructive-action catalog entries have preview or explicit force semantics.
nonfunctional_requirements.verification: Interaction and CLI contract tests.
